text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Phew! Another fine day of training in the books. Right, time to tidy up the equipment and head on home—ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CLUNK!
WHOOOAAAA! There you… are?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! Fine?! Y-you're not the monster everyone's been talking about.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, I'm sorry for surprising you. By the by… what's this about a monster?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You haven't heard?! Recently, something's been haunting this very gym!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Be careful on your way back to the dorm! I'm not quite done here yet…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: H-heroes do not fear specters and the like! I will complete today's training regimen… I'm n-n-not just going to wallow in t-terror!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see… Trainer, would you mind if I stayed and trained a little longer as well?
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself any harder…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Hey, Biko, mind if I join you? I'd like to hear more about these rumors.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: O-of course! They say that every night, a skeletal figure appears to use the leg-press machine…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh dear! A skeleton doing muscle training?! I wonder what its motivation could be!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I wonder too. If this b-bony body-builder makes an appearance, p-perhaps we should ask it together! A hero should exchange words before fists!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Fine Motion joins Biko Pegasus, who's putting on her best brave face, for some additional training exercises.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm. I suppose this could be considered overkill. Still…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh… are you worried about me, Fine? …If that's the case, you can rest easy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: If the specter emerges, I'll beat it back into the afterlife! Even if it is terrifying… No! It's precisely because it's terrifying that I must spare everyone else its terror!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow, you really are brave! Far beyond my expectations…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I have underestimated you. In recognition of your courage, I hereby bestow upon you a clover that will grand you sacred protection.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Th-this is amazing! It's like getting a sprout talisman from Honey Princess! I feel like I'm positively buzzing with bravery now! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Let's hope that it keeps you out of harm's way. Good night.
